We need propose a 3-step retrosynthesis for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: steps forward: 1) sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). 2) Doebner modification to form α,β-unsaturated acid (then maybe amide formation). 3) amide coupling (carboxylic acid to amide). So retrosynthetic steps: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride and aniline. Break amide to give carboxylic acid and aniline. Break α,β-unsaturated acid to give aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. So retro: break the C=C bond to give aromatic aldehyde (p-? ) and malonic acid.

Thus propose route:

Target (A): p-tolyl-sulfonamide attached to phenyl ring with α,β-unsaturated amide.

Step 1 (retro): disconnect sulfonamide: give sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2Cl) and aniline (the aryl amine). So precursor 1: p-tolyl-sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl ring? Actually sulfonyl chloride attached to second phenyl ring (c2ccc...). The sulfonyl chloride would be: ClSO2-Ph-... The amine is the tolyl aniline (p-toluidine). So product after step1: sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-Ph-... with the unsaturated amide side chain) and p-toluidine.

Step2 (retro): disconnect amide: give carboxylic acid (the α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (anilide). The acid is the same unsaturated acid attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)...)...). So precursor: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl ring, and aniline (c3ccccc3N). That's the amide formation step.

Step3 (retro): disconnect α,β-unsaturated acid to aldehyde + malonic acid via Doebner modification. The aldehyde is the aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) attached to sulfonyl chloride? Wait the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl ring that also bears sulfonyl chloride. So the aldehyde precursor would be the same phenyl ring bearing sulfonyl chloride and aldehyde group (Ar-CHO). So step3: aromatic aldehyde (with sulfonyl chloride) + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid.

Thus final precursors: (i) p-toluidine, (ii) aromatic aldehyde bearing sulfonyl chloride, (iii) malonic acid.

We need to provide JSON route with three reaction nodes.

We need template IDs for each reaction. We can search for sulfonamide formation template, amide coupling, Doebner modification. Let's search.
